voyage.name: Colline du Château
voyage.content: The castle hill overlooking the Baie des Anges and harbour offers a spectacular vantage point overlooking the city. Not much is left of its ruined castle besides crumbling walls. Still, climbing up the stairs to reach the platforms 90 m above Nice is well worth the view. There is also a lift (ascenseur) which will take you three quarters of the way up. The castle hill park closes at around sunset. Expect to be escort

voyage.name: Parc Phoenix
voyage.content: 2500 different plants in botanical garden and tropical glass house. Also various animals.

voyage.name: Musée des Arts Asiatiques
voyage.price: Free visit, conference, Qi Gong and Tai Chi Chuan
voyage.hours: Jul Aug: Wed-Mon 10:00-18:00; Sep-Jun: Wed-Mon 10:00-17:00; closed Jan 1, May 1 and Dec 25
voyage.content: Indian, Chinese, Southeast Asian, and world art in great architecture on a lake.

voyage.name: Musée Marc Chagall
voyage.price: Full rate €8, reduced rate €6, free for students below 26 and for everybody every first Sunday of the month
voyage.hours: May-Oct: 10:00-18:00; Nov-Apr: Wed-Mon 10:00-17:00; closed on Tue and on Jan 1, May 1, Dec 25
voyage.content: Even if you are not in art, this is a museum which should not be missed. It includes stained glass windows by the artist.

voyage.name: Musée Matisse
voyage.content: Charming collection of paintings, drawings and sculptures in 17th-century Genoese villa.

voyage.name: Musée d’Archéologie de Nice
voyage.hours: May-Oct 10:00-18:00; Nov-Apr 10:00-17:00; closed Tue and major holidays
voyage.content: The ruins of the Gallo-Roman settlement in Cimiez, plus a museum with nice documentation on Gallo-Roman life (but mostly not in English). Activities for children. Guided tours available.

voyage.name: Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art
voyage.alt: MAMAC, Musée d'art moderne et d'art contemporain de Nice
voyage.hours: May-Oct: Tue-Sun 10:00-18:00; Nov-Apr: Tue-Sun 11:00-18:00; closed Jan 1, May 1, Dec 25
voyage.content: It has four connected towers featuring modern and contemporary artists and their sculptures, paintings, and conceptual installations. Its open-air roof terraces offer one of the best panoramas of the city.

voyage.name: Musée des Beaux-Arts Jules Chéret
voyage.hours: May-Oct: Tue-Sun 10:00-18:00; Nov-Apr: Tue-Sun 11:00-18:00; closed Jan 1, Easter May 1, Dec 25
voyage.content: To the west, there is the Musée des Beaux-Arts, housing an excellent collection of pastels and other works by Jules Cheret, among other artists.

voyage.name: Chateâu de Bellet
voyage.content: Château de Bellet has a winery, vineyards and wine tastings in a deconsecrated chapel. The wine cellar, built in 2015, is partially underground and semi-circular in shape, conceived for the reception of the grape by gravity and the ageing of wines in optimal conditions. The visit includes a secret crypt in the chapel.

voyage.name: Cliff Walk
voyage.content: You can follow the path around Cap de Nice half way to Villefranche, but be prepared for several hundred steps up to rejoin the road. It’s a very beautiful walk and you will find mostly local people using it.

voyage.name: Train des Pignes
voyage.price: Nice – Puget-Théniers – Entrevaux round trip: adult €37.4, child (up to 11 years old) €24.8; Nice – Puget-Théniers – Annot – round trip: adult €40.4, child €26.8; Nice – Puget-Théniers – Le Fugeret round trip: adult €48.4, child €33.8
voyage.content: A regular SNCF train departs from Nice to Puget-Théniers, where it connects to a narrow-gauge railway through the mountains and valleys of the hinterland. A very scenic but less comfortable ride than the SNCF main lines. Terminates at Nice-CP station a few blocks behind Nice-Ville main station. Leaves in the morning, and returns in the evening. Reservations for the steam trains are mandatory.

voyage.name: Opéra Nice Côte d'Azur
voyage.content: This opera house hosts not only opera performances but also many concerts of the Orchestre Philharmonique de Nice and chamber music recitals, and some ballet performances. The house's website is in French only, but even if you don't read French well, you should be able to make out the information on their calendar (calendrier).

voyage.name: Flower Market
voyage.content: Originally a 19th-century flower market, this street market is now full of produce and baked goods, and some souvenirs.

voyage.name: Marché aux Fruits et Legumes
voyage.content: Food market.

voyage.name: Confisserie Florian
voyage.content: This gourmet shop has specific jams, sweet fruits and petals, which are traditional from that area. The candied clementine and the rose jam are their fine specialities.

voyage.name: Fennocchio's
voyage.hours: Mar-Nov: daily 10:00-12:00 (one store closed on Tue)
voyage.content: Serves ice creams and Italian-style ices. It's a tough choice to select just one or two of the 94 flavours, which include classics like chocolate or vanilla and less usual ones like thyme, cactus or lavender. 2 locations in the Old Town.

voyage.name: Lou Pilha Leva
voyage.content: Local dishes including the best tasting Socca, which only costs €2.80 (April 2019). Locals (and the lots of French tourists) seem to love this place and it is often quite busy. Order your food at the counter and take it with you to sit at the benches outside. Try Daube pasta/polenta for €9.50 (April 2019) and soupe au pistou, and socca. Very nice atmosphere and very decent price. Worth a try, even though the baked fo

voyage.name: L'americano
voyage.content: Friendly welcome, fast service, excellent pizza. Very good food, variety of dishes

voyage.name: Chez Palmyre
voyage.content: French cuisine. Nice restaurant with very pretty decor. Very warm welcome and friendly. Excellent cuisine. You'll probably find yourself seating at the same table with other people, which makes the experience even better

voyage.name: Nomad Bar
voyage.content: The best staff, and amazing food. A welcoming, authentic and pleasant place.

voyage.name: Le Barbecue
voyage.content: Succulent Portuguese cuisine. Great portions and divine food. In addition to the friendliness and kindness of all the staff. The terrace is very picturesque.

voyage.name: Mi Casa
voyage.content: Delicious food, best value in the area by far. Great service, cute dog. Delicious, beautiful setting, friendly atmosphere.

voyage.name: Chez Moi
voyage.content: The exceptional service and the atmosphere of the restaurant makes this place a memorable experience. A real treasure to stumble upon this hidden gem of a restaurant. Great decor and fantastic food.

voyage.name: Pékin
voyage.content: Vegan restaurant. This all-you-can-eat restaurant is simple but perfect for all appetites. Amazing food. Very nice host.

voyage.name: La Riviere Des Parfums
voyage.content: Excellent home cooking, very welcoming. Hearty Vietnamese dishes full of flavors.

voyage.name: Dai Long
voyage.content: The feeling of a very familiar hometown restaurant. Good and authentic Chinese food.

voyage.name: Le Shalimar
voyage.content: Has tasty Indian food. Lunch menus are a good deal.

voyage.name: Mad'In Viet
voyage.content: Vietnamese restaurant. Serves good Vietnamese food at affordable prices. Rice is not included in the dishes but ordered separately. Chopsticks are provided but you have to ask for a fork and a knife. The staff are very friendly but speak next to no English, so be prepared to order in French. Main courses €12-20.

voyage.name: Restaurant Festin d'Asie
voyage.content: One of the most authentic Chinese food in France. The owner and the wife of the owner are very attentive and enthusiastic in cooking.

voyage.name: chez alex
voyage.content: Hidden gem in Nice! It kept this traditional French bistrot atmosphere. The staff is genuine and welcoming. The food is delicious.

voyage.name: La Casa Della Piadina
voyage.content: Excellent fresh Italian sandwiches. Rich, high-quality ingredients and nice owners.

voyage.name: 7 Days
voyage.content: Amazing local pizza and lovely owner. The pizzas are amazing, very tasty and good size.

voyage.name: Receta de Jou
voyage.address: 4 Pl. de la Gare du S
voyage.content: Typical French place with homemade food. One of the best pissaladières in Nice. Lots of very nice little dishes, very fresh and delicious.

voyage.name: La Casa di Giulia (Casa di Giorgio)
voyage.content: Super nice little restaurant, fresh and excellent products, lovely service. Generous cuisine, fresh products, sauces to die for, a treat.

voyage.name: Socca'Tram
voyage.content: Best Socca in Nice. The portions are generous. Very pleasant experience, smiling and pleasant servers.

voyage.name: Cok Bafa
voyage.content: Great typical Portuguese and Cape Verdean restaurant. Braised chicken formulas to die for. Great and beautiful restaurant.

voyage.name: Sixte Pizza
voyage.content: Pizzas for €6; taking them away to the beach makes for a nice dinner. The pizza menu is appealing for its originality and humor. Very tasty pizza.

voyage.name: Made In Sud Pizzeria
voyage.content: Wood-fired oven pizzas, made in front of the customers. Great Neapolitan pizza.

voyage.name: Borghese Lust
voyage.content: The ambiance is great, contemporary, and the staff are friendly welcoming with genuine smiles. Very nice decoration.

voyage.name: Chez Pipo
voyage.content: A good Mediterranean restaurant where you can taste specialties from Nice. The socca is good there and the other dishes too.

voyage.name: The Golden Socca
voyage.content: Very good restaurant in terms of their specialty socca. Impeccable service. Generous and good socca and pizza. Simplicity and kindness.

voyage.name: le Delhi Belhi
voyage.price: €15-20 per person (alcoholic drinks and wine are extra)
voyage.content: Delhi Belhi is a family-owned and -operated restaurant specializing in Indian cuisine. Open daily for dinner, à-la-carte or prix-fixe menu. Great curries and tandoori specialties. Delhi Belhi is the only Indian restaurant on the entire French riviera that has been included in the prestigious Gault-Millau guides since 2005. Fluent English also spoken here. Behind the popular cours Saleya flower market. This is a very

voyage.name: Le Lodge
voyage.content: If you're watching your budget but want to have a gourmet, healthy meal, this is the place to go for lunch. For €11 you get a main course, a drink such as wine, beer or soda and after the meal, a coffee. Try the trio of fish. For €13, add the dessert of the day. Hopefully it's cinnamon crème brûlée. Don't be put off by the one waitress to a full restaurant ratio, the chefs get the food to you quickly. The meal deals

voyage.name: Restaurant du Gésu
voyage.content: In the heart of Vieux Nice, this is a friendly, vibrant, old-fashioned restaurant with as much Italian influence as Provençale. The beignets and daube with gnocchi are particularly good. €15-30 (Dec 2020).

voyage.name: Le Tire Bouchon
voyage.address: Rue de la Préfecture/Rue de l'Abbaye 19
voyage.content: Le Tire Bouchon is an attractive, desirable restaurant in which to enjoy a classic bistro-café meal. The restaurant has a picturesque atmosphere that everyone is sure to enjoy.

voyage.name: Le Lavomatique
voyage.content: The former small lauderette or laundry shop is transformed in to a modern bistro and hosted by two brothers who are passionate about bistronomy. The chefs offer fresh, local ingredients listed in a seasonal menu in a French tapas bar format. Several tapas dishes per person will round out comfortable portions.

voyage.name: Peixes
voyage.content: Peixes, pronounced 'pêche' specializes in affordable fish and seafood served in a modern form of small plates or tapas. Peixes is a small restaurant with blue and white tiles and a Mediterranean ambiance. Mentioned in the Michelin Guide.

voyage.name: Terres de Truffes
voyage.price: €8 for takeout up to €42 for a restaurant main plate
voyage.content: Takeout, delivery or eat-in bistro where you can taste all varieties of truffles paired with food and wine. Takeout includes small bottles of truffle oil.

voyage.name: Paper Plane
voyage.content: Casual breakfast/brunch/lunch place with a focus on pancakes. All vegetarian, mostly vegan. The "planted steak" is delicious.

voyage.name: Le Chantecler
voyage.content: The Chantecler is a two-star Michelin restaurant and a destination of many gourmets and foodies. Extraordinary gastronomy by Master Chef Virginie Basselot mixes lightness and complexity with renowned table service. The menu offers a talented tribute to regional products. Guests are hosted in a period restaurant with amazing woodwork dating back to 1751.

voyage.name: Flaveur
voyage.content: Restaurant Flaveur is a restaurant worth searching as described in the Michelin Guide that gave it two-star Michelin rating. The passion of these two brothers lifts this restaurant to among the best in France. Flaveur is a restaurant to 'splurge'.

voyage.name: Jan
voyage.content: Restaurant Jan is a one-star Michelin restaurant featuring South African chef Jan Hendrik van der Westhuizen. The 24-seat formal dining room allows wait staff to focus on each guest and present the finest local produce from the markets of the south of France. Splurge on a bottle of South African wine. Across the street, private dining room is available where guests can enjoy a mid-meal interlude with 20 cheeses and t

voyage.name: Le Plongeoir
voyage.hours: Lunch and dinner (closed Tue evening and Wed)
voyage.content: Le Plongeoir is perched high above the sea on a famous pillar of rock overlooking the port of Nice and offering a stunning and memorable view. Platform diving boards (hence the name) pre-date the restaurant. The menu features fresh and inventively prepared seafood with a modern Mediterranean influence, prepared with fresh, seasonal market produce. The hip lounge bar is a place to see and be seen; the bar is open from

voyage.name: Ma Nolan's
voyage.content: Right in the heart of the 'Old Town' and next to the opera, Ma Nolan's has everything you would expect from an Irish pub: live music every night, major sporting events on four screens, really good food and very friendly staff.

voyage.name: Akathor Pub
voyage.content: — Big Scandinavian/Irish pub with live music every night. On two floors with a large terrace this place is expensive but chill. Many of the larger hotels (such as the Holiday Inn) have 2-for-1 drink coupons which can be easily obtained even if you are not a guest.

voyage.name: Wayne's
voyage.content: — An old school bar with live music and theme nights, a bit coyote ugly meets cheers. When the place is crowded, people dance on the tables. It's somewhat expensive to drink here (but Wayne's isn't alone with this characteristic), but definitely one of the most fun/party places in Nice. English-speaking tourists also seem to gravitate to this bar, but you'll also meet lots of French people or locals here.

voyage.name: L’Essenciel Bar Panoramique
voyage.content: Lounge bar at the pool on top of the hotel. Relaxed atmosphere and great views over the city.

voyage.name: Le Blue Whales
voyage.content: Created in 1993. Rock ambiance for young folks. Live music, live sports and Trivia Night entertainment Wednesdays at 20h00. The restaurant offers typical pub grub and a few salads.

voyage.name: Villa Saint Exupery
voyage.content: An amazing hostel with a great party vibe, includes free internet and free breakfast. Situated a short way to the north of the town centre in a former monastery. You can easily catch a bus there from Nice Ville train station (1, 2 or 23), the staff are very helpful, knowledgeable and will even pick you up free if you arrive late.

voyage.name: Backpacker's Hostel Chez Patrick
voyage.content: A clean, cheap hostel with dorm rooms and a shared kitchen. The host is very kind and helpful and you're just a few minutes from the Nice train station (Gare SNCF) and a few metres away from the next tram station.

voyage.name: PV-Holidays Résidence Maeva Nice Les Palmiers
voyage.content: A renovated three-floor residence, located in a private garden in the heart of the Fabron district. 500 m from the shops, 800 m from the beach, 4 km from the old port of Nice and 6.5 km from the airport.

voyage.name: Hotel Riviera Nice - Best Western Collection
voyage.content: Hotel in an Art Deco building.

voyage.name: Hotel Anis
voyage.content: Swimming pool, restaurant.

voyage.name: Le Mas des Selves
voyage.content: Beautiful Bed and Breakfast.

voyage.name: Citadines Nice Buffa
voyage.content: Well appointed and plenty of room but, be prepared for a bit of a walk to most attractions and the city centre. Several supermarkets close by and several bus routes pass right outside (if you can decipher the timetables!)

voyage.name: Hotel Canada
voyage.content: Quaint would be too nice to describe this place. Is not the best. But it is in the middle of Nice, good friendly staff too. €55/65 a night for single/double.

voyage.name: NH Nice
voyage.content: This hotel offers a gym, sauna, swimming pool.

voyage.name: L'Hôtel Suisse Nice
voyage.price: €138 to €400; seaview and balconies are more expensive
voyage.address: 15 Quai Raubà Capéù, Promenade des Anglais
voyage.content: Very close to the sea and the old quarter. Free Wi-Fi. The Superior and Privilege rooms have a small balcony with a table and two chairs where you can sit and view the surf along the entire waterfront. The rooms are typically French sized small but well decorated. Business services.

voyage.name: Gounod
voyage.content: Free use of pool and whirlpool in next door Hotel Splendid.

voyage.name: Arome Hotel Nice
voyage.content: Small but cozy hotel in the city center with a bed-and-breakfast vibe; two blocks away from the oceanside and walking distance to most sights. Owners are friendly and will try to accommodate things like early check-in. Stairs may pose a problem for those with heavy luggage, windows sometimes open to noisy streets.

voyage.name: Le Grimaldi Hotel
voyage.content: 4-star hotel.

voyage.name: La Perouse
voyage.content: Perched upon a hillside overlooking the Baie des Anges and Old Village. Large rooms and suites, some with a terrace and private hot tub. Concierge and valet services. Pool, jacuzzi, fitness and solarium. Business and seminar areas.

voyage.name: Boscolo Exedra Nice
voyage.content: Upscale Italian chain with spa and fine dining in the city centre.

voyage.name: Negresco
voyage.content: Famous landmark hotel. Houses Le Chantecler, a bar and a brasserie. Worth a look even if you are not staying there. Can be very expensive depending on season.

voyage.name: Le Soleia Nice
voyage.content: Boutique hotel, pets allowed.
